f_definition: Provisional, NOT a team decision yet. f = distance before the trigger year (2027), with the trigger year itself at full fidelity (f=1): {"2025": 0.0, "2026": 0.5, "2027": 1.0, "2028": NaN, "2029": NaN, "2030": NaN, "2031": NaN, "2032": NaN}. Years 2028-2032 (after the trigger, never seen in training) are marked f=NaN and treated as an extrapolation regime (Q3), scored by probes fit on the interior (2025-2027) rows but never trained on.
